scenarios.assertion: An interrupted participant connection retains the last authoritative projection and blocks mutation while offline.

tests.name: blocks mutation while offline and retains the last projection

scenarios.assertion: A participant joining after play has advanced adopts the current authoritative phase and does not replay historical phases.

tests.name: GAME-QA-04 late join adopts the current phase without replaying history

scenarios.assertion: Resuming the participant app requests one fresh authoritative projection before normal interaction continues.

tests.name: resume resynchronizes the active game projection

scenarios.assertion: A native-TV process restart restores its device credential and fetches the current projection without issuing another pairing challenge.

tests.name: GAME-QA-04 TV restart restores credential and authoritative snapshot

scenarios.assertion: Duplicate participant submissions coalesce behind one in-flight idempotent mutation while a conflicting selection fails closed.

tests.name: coalesces duplicate submissions while one request is in flight

scenarios.assertion: Participant and native-TV reconcilers retain the newest accepted projection when stale versions, duplicate versions, older server times, or out-of-order sequences arrive.

tests.name: reconciler ignores older server time and event sequence

scenarios.assertion: The participant countdown derives its remaining duration from authoritative server time and the authoritative phase deadline instead of the device wall clock.

tests.name: GAME-QA-04 clock skew uses authoritative server-time deadline delta

scenarios.assertion: Participant role revocation blocks actions, reports a typed permission failure, and does not turn retained content into fabricated confirmation.

tests.name: permission revocation blocks actions without dropping content

scenarios.assertion: Native-TV device revocation deletes the stored credential, clears the projection, and enters a fail-closed revoked state.

tests.name: revocation deletes the credential and fails closed

scenarios.assertion: A failed refresh retains only the last authoritative projection and exposes a sanitized failure without enabling stale actions.

tests.name: GAME-QA-04 partial refresh failure retains state then recovers

scenarios.assertion: A Realtime channel failure triggers a bounded authoritative snapshot refresh and returns the participant synchronizer to current state.

tests.name: recovers from a Realtime channel error with a fresh snapshot
